FAQ

Selling surplus non-woven fabric rolls

What non-woven fabric rolls do you buy?

We buy PP, PET, PS and PE non-wovens, including spunbond, spunlace and air laid materials, hydrophobic and hydrophilic fabric, medical garment laminates, wipes, dressings and filter materials.

Which industries do your non-woven rolls come from?

We buy rolls from medical and hygiene manufacturers, filtration makers, wipes converters, automotive suppliers and personal care brands, as well as non-woven fabric mills.

Do you take large quantities?

Yes. Large quantities will not scare us. We'll take full trailer loads of surplus rolls as well as partial loads.

What details should I send?

Non-wovens vary a lot, so the more detail the better: the polymer, the process (spunbond, spunlace or air laid), the basis weight, width, any treatment, the gross weight on hand and your location. Photos help.

Why sell surplus rolls instead of throwing them out?

Selling to a roll buyer recaptures value, clears space for product and cuts your disposal costs. We'll recover what we can.

How fast can you pick up?

We buy rolls across North America and can usually have a truck at your warehouse within 48 to 72 hours.
